data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use libcurl for HTTP calls in Android, iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin using libcurl via FFI for making HTTP requests in Android, iOS, and macOS apps. Supports advanced connectivity features like HTTP2, ALPN, Brotli compression, and experimental HTTP3.
use_when: You need advanced networking features like HTTP2, ALPN, or Brotli compression not available in standard dart:io.
You want to use libcurl bindings via FFI for HTTP operations on Android, iOS, and macOS.
avoid_when: You need a pure Dart HTTP client without native library binaries.
You are targeting platforms other than Android, iOS, and macOS.
strengths: Supports HTTP2 and ALPN automatic upgrades.
Supports Brotli compression and experimental HTTP3.
Runs cURL APIs in a separate isolate using dart:Ffi to prevent app blocking.
weaknesses: Relies on pre-built native binaries for Android, iOS, and macOS which can increase app size.
Experimental support for HTTP3 and alt-svc.
data.setup_notes: Downloads Curl binaries via Gradle for Android and via pod install/SPM for iOS. Android minimum SDK is 21 and iOS minimum version is 12.2.
